name: @taurean/suede-css
description: a starter set of CSS files
author: Taurean Bryant <later@taurean.work>

scripts.release:patch: npm run lint && npm run check:skill && git fetch origin && git pull origin main && npm version patch && npm run build && git add dist/ && git commit -m 'Build files' && git push origin main --tags && npm publish --access=public
scripts.release:minor: npm run lint && npm run check:skill && git fetch origin && git pull origin main && npm version minor && npm run build && git add dist/ && git commit -m 'Build files' && git push origin main --tags && npm publish --access=public
scripts.release:major: npm run lint && npm run check:skill && git fetch origin && git pull origin main && npm version major && npm run build && git add dist/ && git commit -m 'Build files' && git push origin main --tags && npm publish --access=public
